note: 29 measured regions: 17 exhibit rows (twelve figure rows and five table rows) and 12 exclusions. The paper prints 16 numbered figures and 6 numbered tables, so 22 exhibits; 17 are measured and 5 are declared gaps rather than given invented bboxes. All five gaps sit on the four pages whose text layer is empty and whose content the layout pass therefore cannot see: p6 prints Figure 3 'Solution Flow for Problem 1', p11 prints Figure 7 '(a) Without Human Intervention;(b) With Herbicide;(c) With Pesticide;(d) With Herbicide and Pesticide' as a 2x2 line grid with a six-entry legend, p21 prints Figure 14 'Determination of Scheme layer D' with Table 6 'Comprehensive evaluation system' (five columns, nine rows, a vertically merged 'Comprehensive benefit A' cell and four merged Standard-layer cells), and p24 prints Figure 16, a six-panel bifurcation grid captioned in running prose. The measurable census is therefore 12 of 16 figures and 5 of 6 tables, and the table numbering has no hole. Table 3 is only half measurable: its caption and first header printing sit on p16 just above the page turn and returned no region, so its row records the repeated header and the single 'New food web' row that p17 returns. Two figures are split by a page turn in the other direction - Figure 8's artwork is printed at the foot of p12 while its caption opens p13. Twelve regions are excluded: nine 693-path watermark blocks, plus three fragment-of-other regions. Each fragment belongs to an exhibit that carries ONE printed number (Figure 8's panel (b), Figure 11's panel (b)) or continues across a page turn (Table 4's second row), which is the same rule used on #423 and #425: a one-number exhibit is one row plus fragments, a two-number exhibit is two rows. Caption positions: every figure caption in this paper is printed BELOW its artwork and every table caption ABOVE its grid, with no exception among the 17 measured rows. Section 4.5's own heading is printed on p11 and its subsection 4.5.1 is printed nowhere the extractor can see, so the Figure 8 row names 4.5.2, the first printed subsection after the artwork. Text-layer defects recorded as printed: p11's prose cites bare panel letters ('Compared to Figure (a)', 'As shown in Figure (b)') with no figure number, p24 prints 'Figure demonstrates the shift of food web dynamics...' with the number missing, Figure 13's caption is cut at the right margin as '(b) Compari-', Figure 15's as '(b) Evaluating ulti-', and Table 4's 'New food web' row disagrees with Table 3's on the same column names. Pages 6, 11, 21 and 24 return zero characters; the running head reads 'Page N of 26' on every body page and the file has 26 sheets. Arithmetic defect recorded as printed: none of the 17 rows carries a printed value that contradicts its own axis, but Figure 13 puts betweenness, closeness and eigenvector centrality on one 'Centrality degree' axis that can only be read if all three share a scale, which the caption never states.
